definition: Sum of view_count over the videos in this snapshot's main search results.
limitations: Covers the top-50 relevance-ranked search results for youtube_query (regionCode=IN) at snapshot time; the set can change between snapshots, so changes mix real growth with a changing sample. Videos with hidden statistics count as 0 in this sum.

definition: Sum of comment_count over the same videos.
limitations: Same sample caveat as video_views_total; videos with comments disabled count as 0.

definition: search.list pageInfo.totalResults of the first page.
limitations: YouTube documents this as an approximation with a maximum of 1,000,000; 8 of 10 pilot products returned exactly 1,000,000, so it carries little signal.

definition: true if the main search had more results than were fetched (a nextPageToken was returned).
limitations: Empty for rows collected before the column existed whose raw file is missing.

limitations: Windows of runs on different days overlap; daily values are rolling 7-day counts.

definition: Videos returned by one search.list call with q=youtube_query, type=video, regionCode=IN, order=date, publishedAfter, maxResults=50.
limitations: Capped at 50 (see cap_hit). order=date relies on the search index, so very new uploads can be missing, and it returns loose matches: in the pilot only 8-74% of titles named the exact model.

definition: Of videos_published_7d, those whose title names the exact model (src/title_match.py: model phrase not followed by a sibling word such as Pro/Max).
limitations: Title-based heuristic; misses videos that name the model only in the description, and is bounded by the 50-result cap.

definition: true if the 50-result cap was hit and more results existed (nextPageToken returned); the true count is then higher than videos_published_7d.
